items.line: SpaceX posts a video and says its launch tower caught Starship ("Mechazilla catches Starship") and congratulates its team. Not checked here.

The fan account GTA 6 Updates says the full tracklist of the GTA 6 album has leaked online, with 34 songs from artists it names, including Travis Scott, Lana Del Rey, Dua Lipa and SZA. Not checked here.
Watcher Guru, a crypto news account, says Bitcoin fell under $65,000 and Ether under $1,800, with over $360,000,000 liquidated in five minutes. Not checked here.
The official League of Legends account, posting from the Worlds 2026 tournament, shares a two-minute video it calls a peek at where the game is headed for 2027. The post gives no details in text.

The New York Post says reports indicate Russia has lifted a ban on killing Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and other Ukrainian leaders. The post names no source for the reports. Not checked here.
Rep. Thomas Massie says he will force a vote to "END THE WAR in Iran" before his term is up. He is quoting another post. Not checked here.
LoL Esports, the League of Legends tournament account, posts that Bilibili Gaming are the 2026 world champions. The post is text and one image. Not checked here.

The account atrupar, which posts political clips, shares a 47-second video and says Sen. John Fetterman suggests he will leave the Democratic Party if Sen. Chris Van Hollen is elected majority leader. Not checked here.

Osint613, an account that posts conflict news, writes that Bahrain is under an Iranian attack. US Central Command says it shot down two Revolutionary Guard drones with no damage; Iran says it destroyed a US radar there. Neither claim is checked here.
Thenewarea51, an aviation news account, says a UPS Boeing 767 collided with a Copa Airlines Boeing 737 at Miami this evening, and credits the audio to the ATC app. Not checked here.
Adam Schefter of ESPN passes on a colleague's report that the Patriots have placed running back TreVeyon Henderson on injured reserve with an illness that is still unexplained.
Sundar Pichai, the head of Google, congratulates SpaceX on the Starship catch. He says it still feels like science fiction and that watching it live was incredible.
Zack D. Films posts a 35-second video captioned "Cutting A Watermelon With Dental Floss". The post gives no more detail.
Reuters reports that Bahrain's interior ministry has issued alerts of potential threats. The post gives no further detail.
The account Science girl posts a video, about two minutes long, with the caption "Snowboarding with descendants of ancient wolves". The post does not say where it was filmed. Not checked here.
Fabrizio Romano, a transfer reporter, posts quotes he attributes to Declan Rice, who says a player named Lamine was kind to his son and that he appreciated it as a father. The post text is cut off.
Elon Musk says he hugged ship 42 upon its return, in a post with no picture or video. Not checked here.
PopBase, a pop music account, says the tracklist for GTA VI: THE ALBUM has leaked online and shows an image of it. Not checked here.
India's prime minister Narendra Modi congratulates India's young cricketers on winning the Men's U-19 Asia Cup 2026.

Dexerto, a gaming news account, says a playable copy of a lost PokePark DS game has resurfaced after 20 years sealed in a PSA grading case, and that fans are asking the collector to open it and dump the ROM. Not checked here.
DeepDiscountsco posts an 82-second video in Japanese saying that Japanese comedy goes over well abroad and is getting big laughs in the West. Not checked here.
MovieTings posts a one-minute video and says Ultron meeting Doctor Doom is a crazy twist, with the hashtag #AvengersDoomsday. The post does not say where the clip comes from.
WAdrewhawkins posts a video of the ship track of the tanker Atlantic Asphalt before its collision at New Orleans on Friday. This site has a story on that collision.

HormuzLetter, a news account, says several helicopters of the US Air Force's 1st Helicopter Squadron flew over Washington, citing initial reports, and adds that Israel says Iran is planning a drone. The post text is cut off there. Not checked here.
TBC_on_X posts a video of about two and a half minutes that it calls "AI Seinfeld" going to the DSA convention. It does not say which tool made it.
DBPerfectShots posts a video captioned "Villains watching Goku vs Kid Buu in Hell", from Episode 280 of Dragon Ball Z. I could not see the clip itself, only the caption.

The account Democrats Deliver says overdose deaths in New York City have dropped 58%. The post carries a photo that the capture does not describe, and gives no source for the figure. Not checked here.
BTS's official account thanks its fans, called ARMY, in a post tagged #MMA2026. Our story on the Melon Music Awards says BTS won Album of the Year and Artist of the Year there.
MySportsUpdate, a sports account, posts a video and says Amon-Ra St. Brown beat Christian Gonzalez for a 56-yard touchdown in a game in Germany. Not checked here.

The AO3 Status account says the fan fiction archive AO3 is back up, with some features switched off so it could return earlier than the four-week mark it had given. It says no AO3 data has been deleted. Not checked here.
ESPN posts a video and says Arch Manning came in clutch for Texas in Death Valley, and that Texas now has its fifth top 25 win of the year. Not checked here.

The account AryePulliNFL posts a short video and says Detroit Lions player Aidan Hutchinson just got hurt celebrating a sack. Adam Schefter of ESPN says the Lions have ruled Hutchinson out with a knee injury. Not checked here.

Politics UK, an account that posts British political news, says the UK Government has confirmed it is considering a "staggered" age of consent, which it says would make relationships between adults and 16 and 17-year-olds illegal. Not checked here.

The account scott_colom says his Delta flight at the Atlanta airport has been delayed for hours because the airline cannot find a pilot, and that hotel vouchers are withheld until it is cancelled. He quotes an unnamed airline worker as saying "pick another transportation secretary." Not checked here.
